prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "Select from instant animated presets or create a custom pet.", "Select Preset Pet"]
1: []
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in to back up your desktop pet and sync across devices."]
3: ["Customize Your Pet's Appearance", "Upload a photo or fine-tune one of our instant template avatars.", "Upload Photo"]
4: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Pick an instant quick-start friend or create a custom pet from scratch.", "Choose Quick or Custom Path"]
5: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Companion...", "Hang tight! We are preparing your pet's animations and desktop interactions.", "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to change settings or put them to sleep."]
6: ["Make sure to sign in with your original account so your adoptable pet data is restored safely.", "Sign in to save your pet's memory, level, and custom traits."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet wandering on your main display. If hidden, click the tray icon in your taskbar to summon them back.", "Shortcut: Press Option/Alt + P to center your pet on screen."]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet to complete the official adoption papers!", "Official Desktop Pet Companion", "Pet Name"]
9: ["Quick Desktop Controls Check", "Try out these basic commands to get familiar with your pet.", "Click pet to pet, drag to move, right-click for controls menu.", "Test Pet Call"]
